criteria.evidence: FlowView.tsx: clicking a topic node calls onSelectContract and opens a `flow-schema` aside with the contract title and `<SchemaTree>`.
SchemaTree.tsx renders each property as name + type label + 'required' badge (from parent `required` array) and recurses into nested objects/array items; no C# syntax.
Topic.Schema json.RawMessage added next to Topic.Contract in topology.go, documented as the contract type's JSON Schema from the host's exporter; keyed to the topic node on the canvas.

Only a passthrough `Connector.Schema` slot and clickable external node were added; the replay itself says 'nothing in this repo authors or emits a connector's schema yet' — no authoring mechanism (file convention, template, CLI merge) exists for developers to describe an SFTP flat file.
Replay ran only `go test ./internal/topology/... ./internal/dashboard/...` plus `go build ./...`; the full `go test ./...` was never run though it could have been.
Turn 4/5: 'the full `tsc -b && vite build`' reported passing; 'Both sides build and test clean.'

judge.reason: The internal half is implemented (topic schema passthrough, JSON Schema field tree with required/nesting, clickable topic nodes) and the web build passes. However the external half is only a data slot with no actual way for developers to author a description in this repo (the replay admits nothing emits it), and the full `go test ./...` was not run; the replay also hit the turn cap.
